note: an HPO annotation below the grade-A bar (grade C in evidence_records): human genetics, curated, but not a clinical synopsis of a single-gene disease

an HPO annotation the curator qualified NOT or Excluded for the disease, or whose patient fraction is zero (load_monogenic_phenotype_annotations writes report_value 0 for these): the one curated statement of absence in the human genetics sources, and the strongest absence here, so it takes the human weight

a placebo-controlled trial arm whose excess over placebo has a 95 percent Newcombe lower bound above 0 (ClinicalTrials.gov) or a FAERS disproportionality signal (PRR >= 2, chi-square >= 4, >= 3 reports)
a trial arm whose risk difference has a 95 percent upper bound below five in a hundred, or a FAERS absence at 2,000 or more drug reports: the weight of the registered placebo rule (amendment item 3)
an IMPC knockout call on a crosswalked MP term (configs/impc_symptom_crosswalk.csv); cross-species, so below the human tiers
an IMPC knockout tested on the crosswalked procedure without a call: a measured absence at the test's power, in a mouse
a PubTator3 cause, stimulate or inhibit relation or a CTD direct-evidence row for the pair; one independent PMID is the unit, text-mined precision is low (Almeida et al. 2024)
